title: DPDP control
description: One atomic, testable requirement derived from the DPDP Act, 2023 and/or DPDP Rules, 2025. One file per control; the file name must equal the id.

id.description: DPDP-<AREA>-<NNN> for catalogue controls. Organisation controls must use their own prefix, e.g. ACME-POL-001.

description.description: Plain-language statement of what must be true.

other.description: Non-DPDP sources, e.g. sectoral regulations or internal policy.

tags.description: Profiles select controls by tag: base, children, sdf, consent-manager, government, ...

confidence.description: high: the text is explicit. medium: the test is a reasonable proxy. contested: credible readings differ; see the note and the linked RFC.

rfc.description: Link to the public interpretation discussion, if any.

review_status.description: draft until a qualified reviewer signs off in the PR.

since.description: Catalogue version in which the control was introduced or last changed in meaning.
